staticText: Private teacher offer and workload checker using actual user-entered contract or payslip figures: base pay, recurring allowances, known deductions, weekly workload and working weeks. It calculates recurring monthly and annual cash, entered take-home and effective hourly cash. Country links identify scoped official education or employment authority starting points but do not prove a salary amount. The tool is not a tax calculation, salary benchmark, entitlement or public-versus-private pay scale.
